description:
Watch the official lyric video for “Sweet Home Alabama” by Lynyrd Skynyrd.
 
‘FYFTY’, the 4CD box set celebrating 50 years of the band is out now! Listen here: lynyrdskynyrd.lnk.to/FYFTY
 
This release features early recordings from Muscle Shoals Studios, rarities unearthed over the years, the 1987 reunion concert, iconic recordings of the modern era of the band up to 2020’s, and legendary anthems of the ‘70s including “Sweet Home Alabama.”
